chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 300: Primal Perfection & a Tearful Reunion? Ji Ning Meets Xiyue
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning’s Primaltwin reaches Primal Perfection and a new sword formation. A commandery princess summons him—and their first glance changes everything.
og_title: The Commandery Princess’s Summons – Desolate Era Ch. 300
og_description: A breakthrough to Primal Perfection, a sword formation that rivals Loose Immortals, and a meeting that begins with a shattering silence.
twitter_title: The moment their eyes met, the world stopped. Desolate Era Ch. 300
twitter_description: Ji Ning powers up his Primaltwin to new heights—but the real battle is emotional when a mysterious princess calls for him.

lore_anchors.definition: The sole remaining family member of Prince Yan, a newly ascended Celestial Immortal. She has been waiting her entire life to meet Ji Ning.
A Celestial Immortal who recently succeeded in overcoming the Heavenly Tribulation, making him an extremely rare and powerful figure in the Grand Xia Dynasty.

A catastrophic trial sent by the Heavenly Dao that a cultivator must overcome to ascend from Earth Immortal/Loose Immortal to Celestial Immortal. Failure usually means death, and success is incredibly rare.
A second cultivation body formed by splitting one's soul. Ji Ning uses his Primaltwin to cultivate the Ki Refining path while his main body focuses on Fiendgod Body Refining.
A set of nine peak Earth-ranked flying swords, forged from the bodies of nine ancient divine sharks. They serve as the core of Ji Ning's Lesser Thousand Sword Formation.
A mid-ranked sword formation technique using multiple flying swords in concert. Ji Ning's Primaltwin can now control over two hundred Earth-ranked swords in its third layer.
